items.context: Kab tak aap ye address change karwana chahenge?
items.text: shaam tak

items.context: Kya main aapka naya address note kar sakta hoon?
items.text: haan ji

items.context: Kya aap delivery address confirm karenge?
items.text: nahi yahi hai
umm mera address change karna hai thoda sa
mera address badal do please main thoda der se hoon
delivery ka address change karna hai kal ka delivery hai
accha ji main naya landmark batata hoon thoda sa
mera address galat likha gaya hai thoda correct kar do
main chahata hoon ki delivery ko mera office bhejo
woh mujhe naya address update karwana hai jaldi

items.context: Kya aap naya delivery date bata sakte hain?
items.text: haan mujhe kal ki delivery ka address change karwana hai

items.context: Kya main aapka naya address le sakta hoon?
items.text: naya address main batata hoon thoda ruk jaiye

items.context: Kya aap landmark detail bata sakte hain?
items.text: delivery ka landmark change karwana hai wo park ke paas
main galti se purana address de diya tha abhi

items.context: Kya delivery office ke liye karni hai?
items.text: haan ji mera office ab same jagah hai par building nayi
Mujhe apne delivery address ko change karna hai kyunki mera ghar shift ho gaya hai ab doosre area mein
Kal ki delivery ke liye address change karna zaroori hai kyunki main uss din apne naye ghar par hi rahunga
Main ne galat address likh diya tha delivery ke waqt mujhe usko turant sahi karwana hai taaki parcel sahi jagah pohonche

items.context: Aap naya delivery address bata sakte hain?
items.text: Ji haan aapka pura naya address bata sakte hain please

items.context: Kya aap delivery address update karwana chahte hain?
items.text: Mujhe apna address change karna hai South Mumbai se Thane ke liye

items.context: Kya aap landmark update karwana chahte hain?
items.text: Main chahta hoon ki delivery wo landmark use ho jo main abhi batane wala hoon

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: change_address - wants to change the delivery address or landmark
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
